candidate_relations.label: Catatonia with stupor
candidate_relations.reason: The clinical record documents a long-standing psychiatric illness (diagnosed 1998, stable on quetiapine) consistent with schizophrenia, a BFCRS score of 23 confirming catatonia with stupor, and abdominal CT findings of dilated intestine with air-fluid levels and no mechanical obstruction consistent with CIPO. C001 correctly identifies the catatonic component but is missing the schizophrenia etiology and the CIPO complication, making it an incomplete subset of the full benchmark diagnosis.
candidate_relations.scope_detail: Captures the catatonic syndrome and one of its features (stupor) but omits the underlying etiology (schizophrenia) and the concurrent gastrointestinal complication (chronic intestinal pseudo-obstruction/CIPO) that are both required components of the benchmark composite diagnosis.

case_quality_flags: Composite benchmark diagnosis requires three components: schizophrenia (etiology), catatonic features (neuropsychiatric state), and CIPO (gastrointestinal complication); single-component candidates will inherently be partial.
